name: Grain Designs
old_description: Built near Fargo, ND, Grain Designs was founded by architectural designers with a passion for craftsmanship. No imported, mass-produced furniture. We use premium materials, thoughtfully designed and built to fit your space.
about:
Grain Designs operates from Fargo, North Dakota, where it was founded in 2013 by architectural designers who began building furniture in a two‑stall garage. The studio has since grown into a design‑and‑build workshop rooted at The Pines, a creative hub where craftsmanship and community intersect.

The company produces custom hardwood furniture for both commercial and residential clients, including reception desks, office desks, conference tables, live‑edge tables, dining tables, and podcast/media desks. Every piece is fabricated from solid hardwoods, finished to order, and delivered fully assembled; typical turnaround is as little as six weeks from design approval.

Grain Designs serves businesses across sectors such as financial services, media production, and corporate workspace design. Its portfolio includes projects for NorthStar Financial (conference tables, sit‑stand desks, shelving), You Betcha! (office desks, podcast table, container bar), and Enclave Companies’ flagship office (meeting tables, conference table, shelving). The firm reports having helped more than 100 businesses outfit their office spaces.

The founders started Grain Designs to create meaningful, well‑crafted furniture that lasts, rejecting imported mass‑production in favor of North Dakota‑made pieces built on client relationships. The company positions its custom work at or below the price of standard commercial office furniture, emphasizing on‑time, on‑budget delivery and a free design consultation that yields detailed drawings and finish options.
